newsitem.title: USA: Conestoga Enterprises to buy Infocore.
newsitem.headline: Conestoga Enterprises to buy Infocore.

text.p: Conestoga Enterprises Inc said Friday it signed a letter of intent to buy Infocore Inc in a deal valued at about $4.8 million.
Conestoga said Infocore is to become a wholly-owned subsidiary.
The letter of intent provides for Conestoga to issue 200,000 shares of common stock to Infocore's shareholders in exchange for all outstanding Infocore shares, Conestoga said.
Infocore, headquartered in King of Prussia, Pa., provides telecommunications and data services throughout eastern Pennsylvania.
